== Summary ==
Test only, not a live card image. Proposed pixel-level fix of [[:File:RG-GEMP-Looking-To-The-Future.png]], compared with the original scan [[:File:RG-C1-Looking-To-The-Future.jpg]]. Adds the lore comma after "them" (comma glyph from the Bad Lifters And Faulty Wings remaster; "it was time for" moved 4 px right). Same dimensions and format as the current remaster. Shown on [[User:Comlink Cursor/Reflections Gold remaster test]].
